info.title: Medications and Ototoxicity
info.subtitle: How certain drugs can affect your ears

rows.title: What ototoxic means
rows.desc: Drugs that can harm the inner ear or nerves

rows.title: Common culprits
rows.desc: Some antibiotics, chemo drugs, and diuretics

rows.title: Warning signs
rows.desc: Ringing, muffled sound, or unsteady balance

rows.title: Do not stop alone
rows.desc: Talk to your prescriber before any change

rows.title: Get a baseline test
rows.desc: Check hearing before and during treatment
